title: Polysomnography and Sleep Testing
summary: Covers diagnostic in-laboratory polysomnography (CPT 95810) for suspected Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) when comprehensive clinical evaluation demonstrates symptoms of excessive daytime sleepiness (Epworth Sleepiness Scale score >= 10 or loud snoring/witnessed apneas) and home sleep apnea testing is contraindicated or indeterminate.

sections.title: Coverage Indications
sections.content:
In-lab attended polysomnography (CPT 95810) is covered for adult patients when ALL of the following criteria are met:
1. Clinical evaluation by physician documenting symptoms of sleep-disordered breathing: habitual loud snoring, witnessed apneas, choking/gasping, or excessive daytime sleepiness.
2. Validated daytime sleepiness assessment such as Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS) score >= 10.
3. Indication for in-laboratory testing over unattended home sleep apnea test (HSAT), such as significant comorbid cardiorespiratory disease, neuromuscular weakness, hypoventilation risk, or prior inconclusive HSAT.

sections.title: Non-Coverage
sections.content: Sleep testing is not covered for chronic uncomplicated insomnia or restless legs syndrome without sleep-related breathing disorder symptoms.

criteria.title: Documented Symptoms of Sleep-Disordered Breathing
criteria.description: Patient exhibits documented symptoms of habitual loud snoring, nocturnal gasping/choking, or witnessed apneas.
criteria.required_evidence: Clinical history recording snoring, witnessed apneas, or nocturnal waking with gasping.

criteria.title: Excessive Daytime Sleepiness (Epworth Score >= 10)
criteria.description: Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS) documented with score of 10 or greater.
criteria.required_evidence: Clinical documentation of Epworth Sleepiness Scale score >= 10.

criteria.title: Indication for In-Lab Polysomnography vs Home Sleep Test
criteria.description: Presence of comorbid cardiopulmonary disease, morbid obesity with hypoventilation, neuromuscular disorder, or failed/inconclusive home sleep test.
criteria.required_evidence: Note detailing reason why home sleep apnea testing is contraindicated or prior inconclusive test.
